basis: read-only; embedded times UTC, commit times IST (UTC+05:30); no run time recorded; the working tree is read, not HEAD: worktreeChanges lists the paths under ledger, results, docs, packs, scripts/changelog that differ from HEAD (this output folder left out)

findings.finding: Timestamps without a time zone (Picus logs written in Windows local time).
findings.evidence: Read as UTC they fall 4.93 to 5.45 h after the commit that added them; read as IST (UTC+05:30) they fall before the commit and the file mtime.
findings.action: Raw tool output left unchanged; docs/v4/C2_ANALYZERS.md states that the times are IST without a zone.

findings.finding: Ledger-cited result with no measurement time and no code hash.
findings.action: The doc of each result states the only dating (docs/v4/H1_ZKVM.md for H1); stretch/h1/run_h1.sh records startedUtc, finishedUtc, tool versions and the sha256 of the sources, Cargo manifests, copies of both Cargo.lock files and the fixture for future H1 runs.

findings.finding: Tracked results ran against a version of harness/v4/security_suite.ts that no commit holds (sha256 5ab87f4403d025a2...).
findings.evidence: 8 file(s): circuit__G12_age, circuit__G13_expiry, circuit__G14_type, circuit__G15_epoch_window, circuit__G16_stmt, circuit__G17_nonce, verifier__sessionKnown, verifier__shape
findings.action: Not reproducible from git; the folder README says so; context only, never a cited result.

findings.finding: Inter-run UTC gaps exceed the recorded monotonic idle, and some runs hold an in-run clock step.
findings.evidence: 81 of 89 gaps exceed idleSec by more than 5 s (median 36.595 s, min 0.0 s, max 672.055 s, total 3604.544 s; per gap in audit.json). 4 runs have a UTC span more than 1 s longer than the child wall time (slots 53, 55, 61, 67; wp ranks in their condition: 26/30, 1/30, 1/30, 11/30); the other runs: median 0.232 ms, max 0.911 ms. 2 of them are the fastest wp of their condition; post hoc, if ranks were uniform, at least that many minima has probability 0.0054. Without those runs: v2/rapidsnark wp median 194.72 to 196.414 ms, IQR 19.704 to 17.548 ms; v3/rapidsnark wp median 239.079 to 239.079 ms, IQR 19.347 to 15.912 ms; v4/rapidsnark wp median 258.332 to 259.409 ms, IQR 16.748 to 17.747 ms (type-7 quartiles as scripts/bench/analyze.py). Excess before a run against its wp: v2/rapidsnark r = -0.269 (n = 30), v3/rapidsnark r = -0.191 (n = 29), v4/rapidsnark r = -0.022 (n = 30). results/v4/bench/cold_v2v3: max excess 0.016 s; results/v4/bench/cold_v4: max excess 0.015 s
findings.action: Cause not established [A]: consistent with the VM's monotonic clock not counting time that UTC counts (for example host standby). The recorded idleSec is a lower bound of the elapsed idle, not the actual idle that the protocol's Fixed idle rule says it records; which gap held the extra time is not established gap by gap, because a clock step can carry lag from an earlier interval. Cross-environment cold ratios compare Windows runs without such gaps against these runs. Raw files unchanged; Deviations note proposed for docs/v4/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md.

findings.finding: The WSL guard reads the VM's own CPU only.
findings.evidence: results/v4/bench_wsl/cold_rs_wsl: median 0.0 %, max 0.1 %, 90 of 90 readings at most 0.5 %; results/v4/bench_wsl/warm_wsl: median 0.1 %, max 0.2 %, 35 of 35 readings at most 0.5 %; results/v4/bench/cold_v2v3: median 16.4 %, max 30.5 %, 0 of 60 readings at most 0.5 %; results/v4/bench/cold_v4: median 12.0 %, max 22.2 %, 0 of 30 readings at most 0.5 %; results/v4/bench/warm: median 10.7 %, max 16.3 %, 0 of 35 readings at most 0.5 %
findings.action: The WSL 'quiesced' flags say nothing about Windows-side load (D-034: nothing else runs on Windows during a WSL window).

findings.evidence: Both forms are UTC; a seconds-only time can compare as earlier than a run in the same second.
findings.action: None for committed files; new writers use milliseconds and Z.

coldGaps.basis: excess = (utcStart of a run - utcEnd of the previous run) - idleSec of the run; idleSec is the runner's monotonic idle (performance.now) rounded to 0.1 s; same session, consecutive records with times. sensitivity: status ok runs per condition, type-7 quartiles (as scripts/bench/analyze.py), all runs and without the runs whose UTC span exceeds aux.childWallMs by more than 1000 ms; excessVsWp: Pearson r of the excess before a run and its wp. pAtLeastThatManyMinimaIfUniform is post hoc.
